name: STABLE BASE RECONSOLIDATION
changes: Rebuilds the release from the stable 15.4.0 storefront instead of stacking further global mobile override layers
Removes mobile-system.css, mobile-certified.css and admin-mobile-system.css from the production package and every HTML page
Keeps verified payment, promo, administrator email and Nova Poshta operational fixes from the later release line
Keeps the minimum payable order total at 1 UAH and clears an applied promo after order creation or cart reset
Keeps administrator and customer auth sessions isolated and uses the protected admin-order-update workflow
Keeps delivered order wording and automatic Nova Poshta delivery reconciliation
Restores the exact 15.4 product-gallery zoom rhythm while committing the decoded image atomically to prevent the first frame from flashing
Reduces the gap between product breadcrumbs and the product gallery on desktop and mobile
Allows customers to select and copy useful content while keeping button and navigation chrome non-selectable
Keeps administrator autofill fields dark and readable
Makes scent-profile questions easier to understand and moves Welcome Credit below the personal recommendations
Keeps genuine reviews visible on slow networks without substituting polished product photography for a customer photo
Uses 4:5 order-item photography in the customer account without increasing the established card height
Raises mobile article table headings from 9 px to 11 px
Synchronizes frontend, PWA, service-worker and backend release identifiers to 15.5.0-RC2.0
